headline: Prime-angle SSE and clean offshore wind — small but worth a paddle.
today: The swell is only 2ft but it is coming from a prime SSE angle and the wind cooperates all day, cross-off then offshore into the evening. It will be clean and playful rather than powerful, so it is a log or fish situation. Work the tide windows and enjoy the glass.

daysToWatch.note: Light WNW at dawn over a prime-angle 6.5s SSE. Early is the move before the S onshore takes over in the afternoon.
Onshore builds to 17mph over a mostly short-period swell — junky and not worth it.
Swell nudges up toward 3ft and the wind goes offshore N in the afternoon with a light evening. The pick of the week if the size holds.
